text:
mia: Kicking off blue->green shift for router service (v2.3.1) in eu-west in 3 mins. Change window 10:15-11:00 UTC. Plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Pin session cookie for sticky routes.
chris: thanks — rollback criteria? can we add an automatic rollback on p95 + error? :eyes:
mia: yes — rollback if p95 latency increases by >200ms sustained for 2m or error rate >=5% for 2m. Also manual abort allowed.
mia: runbook snippet:
```
# set initial weights
routectl set-weight --service router --to green=5 --from blue=95 --region eu-west
# probe for 2 minutes, then bump to 20%
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled shift: router v2.3.1 -> green. Next action in 180s. Starting canary at 10:15:00 UTC.
oliver: I'll watch LB health and infra metrics (p95, 502s, connection failures).
chris: I'll watch app traces and deploy logs.
10:15:18 deploy-bot: step 1 executed: green=5, blue=95. Probing...
oliver: seeing a small spike in 502s on green right now — 3.8% over baseline (10:16).
oncall-bot: ALERT: router-green 502-rate 4.8% (10:16:30) — threshold 4% triggered.
sarah: hmm that's above our error threshold for canary. Recommend abort and drain green.
mia: Agreed. Abort the ramp. Deploy-bot, revert weights to blue=100 and initiate drain of green.
deploy-bot: command acknowledged. Reverting weights to blue=100. Starting graceful drain on green nodes.
10:16:52 deploy-bot: revert complete: blue=100, green=0. Draining connections from green, will evict once sessions finish (max grace 90s).
chris: confirming traces show failed upstream on green tasks, consistent with 502s. Good abort.
oliver: infra metrics returning to baseline after weight revert. p95 back to normal. :thumbsup:
mia: filing postmortem notes and adding a follow-up to investigate the green build's health checks and env parity.
sarah: create a short blameless summary and schedule a re-run after fixes.
deploy-bot: Incident recorded: shift aborted, rollback completed. Run id: rb-1769994321.
mia: thanks all. We'll re-open a thread for a second attempt once the health-check fixes are in.
chris: +1, please include the failing probe logs. I'll start a quick grep on recent 502 traces.
oliver: copied logs to /svc/router/archives/1769994321/ and shared with the team.
mia: end of thread — pairing on postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC. :calendar:
